let __ppaHudNextAt=0;
function update(){
  PPAOnlineTick();
  ppaCleanupDeathRemnants();
  updateConsumableHud(false);
  updatePremiumRegen();
  if(P.dead)return;
  v174AiTickPlayerDebuffs();

  const _smartMove=updateSmartAttackInput();
  // V139: Smart Attack only supplies movement when joystick is neutral.
  // Any live joystick input keeps full manual movement while target lock stays active.
  const _moveX=_smartMove?_smartMove.x:jX;
  const _moveY=_smartMove?_smartMove.y:jY;

  // V174: class-AI crowd control is numeric only (no particle FX).
  const _aiMoveMul=Date.now()<(P.aiRootUntil||0)?0:(Date.now()<(P.aiSlowUntil||0)?Math.max(.30,Number(P.aiSlowMul)||.55):1);
  P.vx=_moveX*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  P.vy=_moveY*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  let nx=P.x+P.vx, ny=P.y+P.vy;

  // Keep in bounds (per scene)
  const sc=SCENES[P.scene];
  nx=Math.max(sc.bounds.minX,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxX,nx));
  ny=Math.max(sc.bounds.minY,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxY,ny));

  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    // Stay on the circular arena floor — no wandering into the black void
    const c=sc.center,rad=460;
    const dx=nx-c.x,dy=ny-c.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(dist>rad){nx=c.x+dx/dist*rad;ny=c.y+dy/dist*rad}
  }else if(P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam'){
    const mv=pvpSlide(P.scene,P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='dungeon'){
    // Dungeon walls — slide along corridors, never clip through
    const mv=dgSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clansiege'){
    const mv=clanSiegeSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    const mv=clanBossMoveWithBodyCollision(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='worldboss'){
    const mv=worldBossMoveWithCrystalCollision(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='fartzone'){
    // Exact user-drawn meadow boundary: outside = solid collision.
    // Do not alter town/building hitboxes or other scenes.
    if(!pointInPolygonFartZone(nx,ny)){
      nx=P.x;ny=P.y;
    }
  }else{
    // Solid buildings — can't walk through walls or across rooftops
    const resolved=resolveCollision(nx,ny);
    nx=resolved.x;ny=resolved.y;
  }

  // The map/wall collision above remains authoritative; this only adds body blocking.
  if(P.scene==='dungeon'||P.scene==='arena'){

  }

  if(P.portalCD>0)P.portalCD--;

  }

let __ppaHudNextAt=0;
function update(){
  PPAOnlineTick();
  ppaCleanupDeathRemnants();
  updateConsumableHud(false);
  updatePremiumRegen();
  if(P.dead)return;
  v174AiTickPlayerDebuffs();

  const _smartMove=updateSmartAttackInput();
  // V139: Smart Attack only supplies movement when joystick is neutral.
  // Any live joystick input keeps full manual movement while target lock stays active.
  const _moveX=_smartMove?_smartMove.x:jX;
  const _moveY=_smartMove?_smartMove.y:jY;

  // V174: class-AI crowd control is numeric only (no particle FX).
  const _aiMoveMul=Date.now()<(P.aiRootUntil||0)?0:(Date.now()<(P.aiSlowUntil||0)?Math.max(.30,Number(P.aiSlowMul)||.55):1);
  P.vx=_moveX*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  P.vy=_moveY*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  let nx=P.x+P.vx, ny=P.y+P.vy;

  // Keep in bounds (per scene)
  const sc=SCENES[P.scene];
  nx=Math.max(sc.bounds.minX,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxX,nx));
  ny=Math.max(sc.bounds.minY,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxY,ny));

  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    // Stay on the circular arena floor — no wandering into the black void
    const c=sc.center,rad=460;
    const dx=nx-c.x,dy=ny-c.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(dist>rad){nx=c.x+dx/dist*rad;ny=c.y+dy/dist*rad}
  }else if(P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam'){
    const mv=pvpSlide(P.scene,P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='dungeon'){
    // Dungeon walls — slide along corridors, never clip through
    const mv=dgSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clansiege'){
    const mv=clanSiegeSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    const mv=clanBossMoveWithBodyCollision(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='worldboss'){
    const mv=worldBossMoveWithCrystalCollision(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='fartzone'){
    // Exact user-drawn meadow boundary: outside = solid collision.

    cx.fillStyle='#9d63db';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy-10,aiVisualSize*.35,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  }
  cx.globalAlpha=1;
  if(_aiHidden&&now>(e.aiSmokeLabelUntil||0)){
    cx.globalAlpha=.22;cx.strokeStyle='#8d8d9a';cx.setLineDash([4,5]);
    cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(sx,sy+e.sz*.35,e.sz*.48,e.sz*.18,0,0,Math.PI*2);cx.stroke();
    cx.setLineDash([]);cx.restore();return;
  }
  const bw=Math.max(78,e.sz*1.25),by=sy-e.sz*.86;
  cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.72)';cx.fillRect(sx-bw/2,by,bw,5);
  cx.fillStyle='#d04fff';cx.fillRect(sx-bw/2,by,bw*Math.max(0,e.hp/e.mhp),5);
  cx.font='bold 10px monospace';cx.textAlign='center';cx.fillStyle='#e7c8ff';
  cx.fillText('ИИ · '+c.name+' · '+['','I','II','III'][e.aiRank],sx,by-6);

  // Compact skill indicator: small "skill button" + its real name.
  if(now<(e.aiSkillBadgeUntil||0)&&e.aiCastName){
    const idx=Number.isInteger(e.aiSkillIndex)?e.aiSkillIndex:-1;
    const tag=idx>=0?String(idx+1):'A';
    const txt=e.aiCastName==='Обычная атака'?'АТАКА':e.aiCastName;
    const tw=Math.min(150,Math.max(64,cx.measureText(txt).width+35));
    const bx=sx-tw/2,yy=by-31;
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(8,8,10,.86)';cx.fillRect(bx,yy,tw,18);
    cx.strokeStyle=idx>=0?'rgba(255,197,88,.95)':'rgba(215,215,215,.75)';
    cx.lineWidth=1;cx.strokeRect(bx+.5,yy+.5,tw-1,17);
    cx.fillStyle=idx>=0?'#8b4f18':'#454545';cx.fillRect(bx+3,yy+3,13,12);
    cx.fillStyle='#fff2c9';cx.font='bold 8px monospace';cx.fillText(tag,bx+9.5,yy+12);
    cx.fillStyle='#ffd783';cx.font='bold 8px monospace';
    cx.fillText(txt.slice(0,22),bx+19+(tw-22)/2,yy+12);
  }

  // Tiny, cheap hit stroke: ranged attacks visibly connect to the target;
  // melee attacks produce a short slash at the player's feet.
  if(now<(e.aiHitFxUntil||0)){
    const px=P.x-cam.x,py=P.y-cam.y;
    const alpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((e.aiHitFxUntil||0)-now)/170));
    cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=alpha;
    cx.strokeStyle=e.aiHitFxType==='magic'?'#b98cff':'#ffbd62';
    cx.lineWidth=e.aiHitFxCrit?3:2;
    if(c.range>150){
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(sx,sy-e.sz*.12);cx.lineTo(px,py-e.sz*.18);cx.stroke();
    }else{
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(px-13,py-18);cx.lineTo(px+14,py+2);
      cx.moveTo(px+11,py-19);cx.lineTo(px-9,py+3);cx.stroke();
    }
    cx.restore();
  }

  cx.textAlign='left';cx.restore();
}

let __ppaHudNextAt=0;
function update(){
  PPAOnlineTick();
  ppaCleanupDeathRemnants();
  updateConsumableHud(false);
  updatePremiumRegen();
  if(P.dead)return;
  v174AiTickPlayerDebuffs();

  const _smartMove=updateSmartAttackInput();
  // V139: Smart Attack only supplies movement when joystick is neutral.
  // Any live joystick input keeps full manual movement while target lock stays active.
  const _moveX=_smartMove?_smartMove.x:jX;
  const _moveY=_smartMove?_smartMove.y:jY;

  // V174: class-AI crowd control is numeric only (no particle FX).
  const _aiMoveMul=Date.now()<(P.aiRootUntil||0)?0:(Date.now()<(P.aiSlowUntil||0)?Math.max(.30,Number(P.aiSlowMul)||.55):1);
  P.vx=_moveX*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  P.vy=_moveY*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  let nx=P.x+P.vx, ny=P.y+P.vy;

  // Keep in bounds (per scene)
  const sc=SCENES[P.scene];
  nx=Math.max(sc.bounds.minX,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxX,nx));
  ny=Math.max(sc.bounds.minY,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxY,ny));

  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    // Stay on the circular arena floor — no wandering into the black void
    const c=sc.center,rad=460;
    const dx=nx-c.x,dy=ny-c.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(dist>rad){nx=c.x+dx/dist*rad;ny=c.y+dy/dist*rad}
  }else if(P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam'){
    const mv=pvpSlide(P.scene,P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='dungeon'){
    // Dungeon walls — slide along corridors, never clip through
    const mv=dgSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clansiege'){
    const mv=clanSiegeSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    const mv=clanBossMoveWithBodyCollision(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='worldboss'){
    const mv=worldBossMoveWithCrystalCollision(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='fartzone'){
    // Exact user-drawn meadow boundary: outside = solid collision.
    // Do not alter town/building hitboxes or other scenes.
    if(!pointInPolygonFartZone(nx,ny)){
      nx=P.x;ny=P.y;
    }
  }else{
    // Solid buildings — can't walk through walls or across rooftops
    const resolved=resolveCollision(nx,ny);
    nx=resolved.x;ny=resolved.y;
  }
  // V104: keep the player's visible foot shadow outside Phoenix/mob shadows.
  // The map/wall collision above remains authoritative; this only adds body blocking.
  if(P.scene==='dungeon'||P.scene==='arena'){
    const _bodyMv=ppaMoveWithWorldBodyCollision(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*.24);
    nx=_bodyMv.x;ny=_bodyMv.y;
  }
  P.x=nx;P.y=ny;
  if(P.scene==='clansiege')clanSiegeUpdateCapture();

  // Portal collision
  if(P.portalCD>0)P.portalCD--;
  if(P.portalCD<=0&&!transitioning&&sc.portal){
    const p=sc.portal;
    if(Math.hypot(P.x-p.x,P.y-p.y)<p.r+20){
      changeScene(p.target);
    }
  }
  // Town teleport -> dungeon (walk into the rune circle)
  if(P.portalCD<=0&&!transitioning&&P.scene==='safe'&&sc.teleport&&sc.teleport.target){

    if(Math.hypot(P.x-tp.x,P.y-tp.y)<tp.r){

  if(P.attacking&&movingForAnim&&P.attackMode!=='melee'&&!playerUsesArcherSprites()&&!playerUsesPriestSprites()&&!playerUsesMageSprites()){

    }

    if(P.scene==='dungeon'&&!e.isBoss&&!e.aggro&&e.hp===e.mhp&&d2>250000){

          else e.animDir=ty<0?0:1;

===== updateSmartAttackInput() @ 95272213 =====
 const r=P.sz*0.28; // small foot collision radius
  let x=nx,y=ny;

  // Plaza mask: keep the player's feet on the paved square.
  // Slide along the edge instead of snagging on it.
  if(!plazaCircleWalk(x,y,r)){
    if(plazaCircleWalk(nx,P.y,r)){ x=nx; y=P.y; }
    else if(plazaCircleWalk(P.x,ny,r)){ x=P.x; y=ny; }
    else { x=P.x; y=P.y; }
  }
  for(const b of BUILDINGS){
    const cx0=b.x-r,cy0=b.y-r,cx1=b.x+b.w+r,cy1=b.y+b.h+r;
    if(x>cx0&&x<cx1&&y>cy0&&y<cy1){
      // Push out along the shortest axis (simple AABB resolution)
      const left=x-cx0,right=cx1-x,top=y-cy0,bottom=cy1-y;
      const min=Math.min(left,right,top,bottom);
      if(min===left)x=cx0;
      else if(min===right)x=cx1;
      else if(min===top)y=cy0;
      else y=cy1;
    }
  }
  return {x,y};
}

// Joystick — V38: one dedicated pointer owns movement.
// This prevents a second finger on ATTACK from becoming touches[0]
// and pulling the character toward the right-side attack controls.
let jA=false,jX=0,jY=0,jPointerId=null;
const jB=document.getElementById('joyB'),jS=document.getElementById('joyS');
const joy=document.getElementById('joy');

function resetJoystick(pointerId){
  if(pointerId!==undefined&&pointerId!==null&&jPointerId!==null&&pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  jA=false;jPointerId=null;jX=0;jY=0;
  jS.style.left='37px';jS.style.top='37px';
}
function updateJoystickFromPointer(e){
  if(!jA||e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=joy.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx=r.left+r.width/2,cy=r.top+r.height/2;
  let dx=e.clientX-cx,dy=e.clientY-cy;
  const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),mx=50;
  if(d>mx){dx=dx/d*mx;dy=dy/d*mx}
  jX=dx/mx;jY=dy/mx;
  jS.style.left=(37+dx)+'px';jS.style.top=(37+dy)+'px';
}
function jPointerDown(e){
  // Ignore extra fingers: only the first pointer that starts on the joystick owns it.
  if(jPointerId!==null)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  // V139: joystick no longer cancels Smart Attack.
  // While the player is steering manually, target lock remains active.
  jPointerId=e.pointerId;jA=true;
  try{joy.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  updateJoystickFromPointer(e);
}
function jPointerMove(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  updateJoystickFromPointer(e);
}
function jPointerEnd(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  try{if(joy.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))joy.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  resetJoystick(e.pointerId);
}

joy.addEventListener('pointerdown',jPointerDown,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointermove',jPointerMove,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointerup',jPointerEnd,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointercancel',jPointerEnd,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',e=>{if(e.pointerId===jPointerId)resetJoystick(e.pointerId)});
addEventListener('blur',()=>resetJoystick());
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)resetJoystick()});

// Attack button: ONE press = ONE attack.
// The button automatically selects the nearest visible living target.
// Holding the button does not repeatedly fire/strike.
let attackQueued=false;
const bA=document.getElementById('bAtk');

// === V138 SMART ATTACK =====================================================
// One tap = select ONE nearest target, run into this class's attack range,
// perform ONE normal attack, then stop. No automatic target chaining.
const SMART_ATTACK={active:false,targetId:null};

function cancelSmartAttack(){
  SMART_ATTACK.active=false;
  SMART_ATTACK.targetId=null;
}

function smartAttackTarget(){
  if(!SMART_ATTACK.active||SMART_ATTACK.targetId==null)return null;
  return EN.find(function(e){
    return e&&e.id==SMART_ATTACK.targetId&&e.hp>0;
  })||null;
}

function smartAttackDistance(target){
  if(!target)return Infinity;
  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&target.isClanBoss){
    return clanBossDistanceFromBody(target,P.x,P.y);
  }
  return Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y);
}

function smartAttackReach(target){
  const range=playerBasicRange();
  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&target&&target.isClanBoss){
    return Math.max(35,range*.90);
  }
  const edge=(target&&target.sz&&target.sz>30)
    ?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4)
    :0;
  // Stop a little inside the legal attack range so moving targets
  // do not instantly step out again.
  return Math.max(35,range*.90+edge);
}

function startSmartAttack(target){
  if(!target)return false;
  SMART_ATTACK.active=true;
  SMART_ATTACK.targetId=target.id;
  P.tid=target.id;

  // V140: NEVER reset/recenter the joystick when Smart Attack starts.
  // If the player is already holding movement, keep jX/jY and pointer ownership
  // exactly as-is. Smart Attack only supplies auto-movement when joystick is neutral.
  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)>0.001){
    P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
    P.meleeAng=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  }
  return true;
}

function updateSmartAttackInput(){
  if(!SMART_ATTACK.active)return null;

  const target=smartAttackTarget();
  if(!target||!targetIsValid(target)){
    cancelSmartAttack();
    P.tid=null;
    return null;
  }

  P.tid=target.id;
  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(.001,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=Math.atan2(dy,dx);

  const joystickActive=Math.hypot(jX,jY)>0.08;

  if(smartAttackDistance(target)<=smartAttackReach(target)){
    // In range: fire once when cooldown is ready.
    // Joystick keeps controlling movement; we do NOT force the hero to stop.
    if(P.shootCD<=0){
      attackQueued=true;
      cancelSmartAttack();
    }
    return joystickActive ? null : {x:0,y:0};
  }

  // If the player is steering, keep the target locked but let joystick movement
  // remain fully authoritative. When joystick returns to neutral, auto-approach
  // resumes toward the same target.
  if(joystickActive)return null;

  // No manual input: run directly toward the selected mob.
  return {x:dx/dist,y:dy/dist};
}
// ========================================================================
function hasTargetLine(e){
  if(P.scene!=='dungeon')return true;
  const dx=e.x-P.x,dy=e.y-P.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(d/45));
  for(let i=1;i<steps;i++){
    const k=i/steps;
    if(!dgWalk(P.x+dx*k,P.y+dy*k))return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function targetIsValid(e){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0)return false;
  if(typeof clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget==='function'&&clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget(e))return false;
  const maxD=P.scene==='dungeon'?520:(P.scene==='clansiege'?1800:((P.scene==='clanboss1'||P.scene==='worldboss')?1250:900));
  const d=Math.hypot(e.x-P.x,e.y-P.y);
  if(e.isAiFighter&&e.aiClass==='assassin'&&Date.now()<(e.aiHiddenUntil||0))return false;
  if(d>maxD)return false;
  if(!hasTargetLine(e))return false;

  // В подземелье цель существует только пока игрок остаётся
  // в комнате этого моба. Вышел из комнаты — метка сразу сбрасывается.
  if(P.scene==='dungeon'&&e.room!==undefined&&!dgPointInRoom(e.room,P.x,P.y,0)){
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function findNear(){
  // Clan raid has one authoritative target. Prefer it directly so mobile
  // attack/skills never lose the boss because of generic mob selection.
  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    const cb=EN.find(function(x){return x&&x.isClanBoss&&x.hp>0});
    if(cb&&targetIsValid(cb))return cb;
  }

  const maxD=P.scene==='dungeon'?520:(P.scene==='clansiege'?1800:((P.scene==='clanboss1'||P.scene==='worldboss')?1250:900)),maxD2=maxD*maxD;
  // Cheap first pass: no Math.hypot and no ray-march through the dungeon mask.
  // Keep only a handful of nearest candidates, then LOS-check those.
  let cand=[];
  for(let i=0;i<EN.length;i++){
    const e=EN[i];if(!e||e.hp<=0)continue;
    if(typeof clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget==='function'&&clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget(e))continue;
    const dx=e.x-P.x,dy=e.y-P.y,d2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
    if(d2>maxD2)continue;
    if(P.scene==='dungeon'&&e.room!==undefined&&!dgPointInRoom(e.room,P.x,P.y,0))continue;
    if(cand.length<4){
      cand.push({e:e,d2:d2});
      cand.sort(function(a,b){return a.d2-b.d2});
    }else if(d2<cand[3].d2){
      cand[3]={e:e,d2:d2};
      cand.sort(function(a,b){return a.d2-b.d2});
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<cand.length;i++){
    if(targetIsValid(cand[i].e))return cand[i].e;
  }
  return null;
}
function playerIsMoving(){
  return Math.abs(jX)>0.08||Math.abs(jY)>0.08||Math.abs(P.vx)>0.15||Math.abs(P.vy)>0.15;
}
function queueAttack(e){
  if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}
  if(typeof clanSiegeCapturing==='function'&&clanSiegeCapturing()){
    showPickup('🏰 Идёт захват замка · атаковать нельзя','#ffe39a');return;
  }
  if(P.dead||transitioning||P.scene==='safe')return;
  if((P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam')&&!pvpCombatEnabled)return;

  // PvP intentionally keeps manual positioning: no auto-chase advantage.
  if(P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam'){
    const pvpTarget=findNearBasic();
    P.tid=pvpTarget?pvpTarget.id:null;
    if(pvpTarget&&P.shootCD<=0)attackQueued=true;
    return;
  }

  // PvE smart attack: nearest visible target in the current legal area.
  const cur=findNear();
  if(!cur){
    P.tid=null;
    cancelSmartAttack();
    return;
  }

  P.tid=cur.id;
  const inRange=smartAttackDistance(cur)<=smartAttackReach(cur);

  if(inRange&&P.shootCD<=0){
    cancelSmartAttack();
    attackQueued=true;
  }else{
    // Even if attack is cooling down, start approaching now and fire once ready.
    startSmartAttack(cur);
  }
}
let _combatAttackInputStamp=0;
function triggerAttackInput(e){
  if(e){
    try{e.preventDefault()}catch(_){}
    try{e.stopPropagation()}catch(_){}
  }
  const now=Date.now();

  // Android may emit pointerdown + touchstart + click for one tap.
  // Accept only one combat command from that group.
  if(now-_combatAttackInputStamp<170)return;
  _combatAttackInputStamp=now;
  queueAttack(e);
}
function attackPointerDown(e){
  try{bA.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  triggerAttackInput(e);
}
function attackPointerEnd(e){
  if(e){
    try{e.preventDefault()}catch(_){}
    try{e.stopPropagation()}catch(_){}
    try{if(bA.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))bA.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  }
  try{bA.blur()}catch(_){}
}
bA.addEventListener('pointerdown',attackPointerDown,{passive:false});
bA.addEventListener('touchstart',triggerAttackInput,{passive:false});
bA.addEventListener('touchend',triggerAttackInput,{passive:false});
bA.addEventListener('click',triggerAttackInput,{passive:false});
bA.addEventListener('pointerup',attackPointerEnd,{passive:false});
bA.addEventListener('pointercancel',attackPointerEnd,{passive:false});
bA.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());

function romanRank(n){return ['','I','II','III'][n]||''}
function updateSkillButtons(){
  var ck=classKeyFromName(P.cls),c=ck?GRIMOIRE_CATALOG[ck]:null;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    let el=document.getElementById('s'+(i+1));if(!el)continue;
    let sk=c&&c.active?c.active[i]:null,rank=sk?skillRank(sk.id):0;
    let left=sk?activeSkillCooldownLeft(sk.id):0;
    let va=sk?(GRIMOIRE_ART[sk.id]||{}):{};
    el.classList.toggle('skillLocked',rank<=0);
    el.classList.toggle('skillCooling',left>0);
    if(rank<=0){
      el.innerHTML='<span class="skillLock">🔒</span>';
    }else if(va.icon){
      el.innerHTML='<img class="skillHudImg" src="'+va.icon+'">'+
        (left>0?'<span class="skillCd">'+Math.ceil(left)+'</span>':'')+
        '<span class="skillRankTag">'+romanRank(rank)+'</span>';
    }else{
      el.innerHTML='<span>'+(sk.ic||String(i+1))+'</span>';
    }
    el.title=sk?(sk.n+(rank>0?' · ранг '+romanRank(rank):' · не изучен')):'Навык';
  }
}
function activeSkillCooldownLeft(id){
  var m=P.activeSkillReady||{},until=m[id]||0;
  return Math.max(0,(until-Date.now())/1000);
}
function setActiveSkillCooldown(id,sec){
  if(!P.activeSkillReady)P.activeSkillReady={};
  P.activeSkillReady[id]=Date.now()+sec*1000;
}
function playerSmokeActive(){
  return (P.smokeUntil||0)>Date.now();
}
function effectivePlayerDodge(){
  var bonus=playerSmokeActive()?(P.smokeDodgeBonus||0):0;
  return Math.min(90,(P.dodge||0)+bonus);
}
function skillEnemyHit(e,mult,col,pen){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0)return 0;
  if(typeof clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget==='function'&&clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget(e))return 0;
  if(e.isAiFighter&&typeof v225AiIsHidden==='function'&&v225AiIsHidden(e))return 0;
  if(e.isAiFighter&&typeof v225AiDodgeRoll==='function'&&v225AiDodgeRoll(e)){showPickup('УВОРОТ ИИ','#9fdcff');return 0}
  if(e.isAiFighter&&typeof v225AiBeginCombat==='function'&&!v225AiBeginCombat(e))return 0;
  pen=Math.max(0,Math.min(.95,pen||0));
  var gearPen=Math.max(0,Math.min(.60,((classBaseKey()==='mage'||classBaseKey()==='priest')?(P.magicPen||0):(P.armorPen||0))/100));
  pen=1-(1-pen)*(1-gearPen);
  var raw=(10+(P.atk||12))*mult*shopDamageMul()*clanDamageMulFor(e);
  if(e.isAiFighter&&typeof v225AiOutgoingMul==='function')raw*=v225AiOutgoingMul(e);
  var dmg=(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&e.isClanBoss)
    ? Math.max(5,Math.floor(raw-(e.def||0)*(1-pen)*0.25))
    : Math.max(1,Math.floor(raw-(e.def||0)*(1-pen)));
  if(e.isAiFighter&&typeof v225AiIncomingDamageMul==='function')dmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(dmg*v225AiIncomingDamageMul(e)));
  e.hp-=dmg;
  applyPlayerVampirism(dmg,.6);
  if(e.isClanBoss){
    clanBossTrackDamage(dmg);
    showPickup('НАВЫК · −'+dmg,'#d9a7ff');
  }
  e.flash=8;e.aggro=true;
  for(var j=0;j<6;j++){
    PT.push({
      x:e.x,y:e.y-6,
      vx:(Math.random()-.5)*7,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*7,
      life:13,ml:13,sz:2+Math.random()*3,
      col:col||'#bb66ff'
    });
  }
  return dmg;
}
function skillTarget(maxRange){
  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    return clanBossSkillTargetDirect(maxRange);
  }

  var e=null;

  // Prefer the current valid target, then fall back to nearest enemy.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    var cur=EN.find(function(x){return x&&x.id==P.tid&&x.hp>0});
    if(cur&&targetIsValid(cur))e=cur;
  }
  if(!e)e=findNear();
  if(!e)return null;

  var dist=Math.hypot(e.x-P.x,e.y-P.y);

  // V85: large clan boss uses an edge-reach bonus.
  // This makes skills react to the visible boss body instead of demanding
  // that the player stand almost inside the boss's center point.
  var edgeBonus=(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&e.isClanBoss)
    ? Math.max(150,(e.sz||176)*0.98)
    : 0;

  if(maxRange&&dist>maxRange+edgeBonus)return null;
  P.tid=e.id;
  return e;
}
function skillCanStart(sk,rank,mp,cd){
  if(typeof clanSiegeCapturing==='function'&&clanSiegeCapturing()){
    showPickup('🏰 Идёт захват замка · навыки недоступны','#ffe39a');return false;

  if((P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam')&&!pvpCombatEnabled){
    showPickup('Подготовка к раунду · урон отключён','#d9ba82');
    return false;
  }
  if(P.scene==='safe'){
    showPickup(sk.n+' · только в боевой зоне','#c990ff');
    return false;
  }
  var left=activeSkillCooldownLeft(sk.id);
  if(left>0){
    showPickup(sk.n+' · перезарядка '+Math.ceil(left)+'с','#8f8fa8');
    return false;
  }
  if((P.mp||0)<mp){
    showPickup(sk.n+' · не хватает маны','#5fa0ff');
    return false;
  }
  P.mp=Math.max(0,P.mp-mp);
  setActiveSkillCooldown(sk.id,cd);
  return true;
}

function clanSiegeLocalClanKey(){
  try{
    const c=CLAN_LOCAL_STATE&&CLAN_LOCAL_STATE.clan;
    if(!c)return '';
    return String(c.id||c.clanId||c.uid||c.name||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  }catch(_){return ''}
}
function clanSiegeTargetClanKey(t){
  if(!t)return '';
  return String(t.clanId||t.clanKey||t.clanName||(t.clan&&((t.clan.id||t.clan.name)))||'').trim().toLowerCase();
}
function clanSiegeIsFriendlyTarget(t){
  if(P.scene!=='clansiege'||!t)return false;
  // Objective crystals are neutral and always attackable.
  if(t.isClanSiegeCrystal)return false;
  const mine=clanSiegeLocalClanKey(),other=clanSiegeTargetClanKey(t);
  if(!mine||!other)return false;
  return mine===other;
}

}

// Arena experience ladder:
// 1–20 dungeon mobs -> Phoenix -> 21–40 dungeon mobs -> Lord of Corruption.
// After the Lord, the next stronger 1–40 cycle starts.
function startWave(){
  waveNum++;
  if(waveNum>42){waveNum=1;arenaCycle++}
  waveActive=true;waveTimer=0;arenaWaveKilled=0;arenaWaveSpawned=0;
  if(waveNum===21){
    arenaWaveTotal=1;spawnArenaBoss();
    const ln=document.getElementById('locName');
    ln.innerHTML='БОСС — ФЕНИКС<div class="sub">Круг '+arenaCycle+' · после уровня 20</div>';
    ln.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>ln.classList.remove('show'),2200);
  }else if(waveNum===42){
    arenaWaveTotal=1;spawnArenaLordBoss();
    const ln=document.getElementById('locName');
    ln.innerHTML='БОСС — ВЛАДЫКА СКВЕРНЫ<div class="sub">Круг '+arenaCycle+' · после уровня 40</div>';
    ln.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>ln.classList.remove('show'),2400);
  }else{
    const level=arenaLevelForStage(waveNum);
    arenaWaveTotal=10+((level+arenaCycle-2)%6);
    arenaFillReinforcements();
    const ln=document.getElementById('locName');
    ln.innerHTML='АРЕНА ОПЫТА · УРОВЕНЬ '+level+'<div class="sub">'+arenaWaveTotal+' мобов · максимум '+ARENA_ACTIVE_CAP+' одновременно</div>';
    ln.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>ln.classList.remove('show'),1500);
  }
}

function checkDungeonTeleportDiscovery(){
  if(P.scene!=='dungeon'||transitioning||P.dead||typeof INV==='undefined')return;
  let unlocked=Math.max(0,Math.min(10,Math.floor(Number(INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked)||0)));
  if(unlocked>=DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.length)return;
  // Unlock only after physically reaching the corresponding main-corridor waypoint.
  let gained=unlocked;
  for(let i=unlocked;i<DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.length;i++){
    const sp=dungeonTeleportRouteWorld(i);if(!sp)break;
    const dx=P.x-sp.x,dy=P.y-sp.y;
    const rr=46*DG_SCALE;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=rr*rr)gained=i+1;
    else break;
  }
  if(gained>unlocked){
    INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked=gained;
    saveGame();
    showPickup('Открыт маршрут телепорта: '+DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES[gained-1].label,'#ffd36b');
  }
}
setInterval(checkDungeonTeleportDiscovery,500);
document.getElementById('dungeonTeleportClose').addEventListener('click',closeDungeonTeleportMenu);
document.getElementById('dungeonTeleportMenu').addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===this)closeDungeonTeleportMenu()});

function checkDungeonTeleportDiscovery(){
  if(P.scene!=='dungeon'||transitioning||P.dead||typeof INV==='undefined')return;
  let unlocked=Math.max(0,Math.min(10,Math.floor(Number(INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked)||0)));
  if(unlocked>=DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.length)return;
  // Unlock only after physically reaching the corresponding main-corridor waypoint.
  let gained=unlocked;
  for(let i=unlocked;i<DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.length;i++){
    const sp=dungeonTeleportRouteWorld(i);if(!sp)break;
    const dx=P.x-sp.x,dy=P.y-sp.y;
    const rr=46*DG_SCALE;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=rr*rr)gained=i+1;
    else break;
  }
  if(gained>unlocked){
    INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked=gained;
    saveGame();
    showPickup('Открыт маршрут телепорта: '+DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES[gained-1].label,'#ffd36b');
  }
}
setInterval(checkDungeonTeleportDiscovery,500);

function ppaResetFreshCharacterInMemory(nickname){
  try{
    var freshInv=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(PPA_FRESH_INV_TEMPLATE));
    Object.keys(freshInv).forEach(function(k){INV[k]=freshInv[k]});
    var freshP=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(PPA_FRESH_PLAYER_TEMPLATE));
    Object.keys(freshP).forEach(function(k){P[k]=freshP[k]});
    try{delete P._saved}catch(_){P._saved=null}

    P.scene='safe';
    P.x=SCENES.safe.startPos.x;
    P.y=SCENES.safe.startPos.y;
    P.vx=0;P.vy=0;P.dead=false;P.tid=null;
    transitioning=false;

    try{EN.length=0}catch(_){}
    try{PR.length=0}catch(_){}
    try{PT.length=0}catch(_){}
    try{LOOT.length=0}catch(_){}
    try{PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length=0}catch(_){}
    try{PLAYER_ARROWS.length=0}catch(_){}

    var nick=String(nickname||'').trim();
    INV.playerName=nick;
    window.PPA_PLAYER_NAME=nick;
    try{
      if(nick)localStorage.setItem('ppaPlayerNameV205',nick);
      else localStorage.removeItem('ppaPlayerNameV205');
    }catch(_){}
    return true;
  }catch(err){
    console.warn('PPA fresh in-memory reset failed:',err);
    return false;
  }
}

function ppaQueueFreshStandaloneCharacter(nickname,className){
  ppaClearLocalCharacterCacheForAccountSwitch();
  // Android content:// may recreate sessionStorage on a document reload.
  // Keep this ONE-SHOT handoff in localStorage instead, then consume/remove it
  // immediately after the clean reload. This prevents the first-start loop.
  try{
    localStorage.setItem('ppaFreshStandaloneCharacterV257',JSON.stringify({
      nickname:String(nickname||''),
      className:String(className||'')
    }));
    return true;
  }catch(_){return false}
}
function ppaConsumeFreshStandaloneCharacter(){
  try{
    var raw=localStorage.getItem('ppaFreshStandaloneCharacterV257');
    if(!raw)return null;
    localStorage.removeItem('ppaFreshStandaloneCharacterV257');
    var x=JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!x||!x.className||!/^[A-Za-zА-Яа-яЁё0-9_]{3,18}$/u.test(String(x.nickname||'').trim()))return null;
    return {nickname:String(x.nickname).trim(),className:String(x.className)};
  }catch(_){
    try{localStorage.removeItem('ppaFreshStandaloneCharacterV257')}catch(__){}
    return null;
  }
}

// Visuals, sizes, damage, AI and the original V103 Phoenix asset are unchanged.
// Collision follows the same visible contact-shadow principle used by clan bosses.
function ppaPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y){
  return{x:x,y:y+(P.sz||60)*.45};
}

function ppaWorldBodyGeometry(e){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0||e.isClanBoss)return null;
  var sz=e.sz||30;

  // Original Phoenix shadow geometry from the V103 renderer.
  if(e.isBoss){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+sz*.55,rx:sz*.60,ry:sz*.20};
  }

  if(e.type&&e.type.slimeScavenger){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+6,rx:13,ry:4};
  }
  if(e.type&&e.type.caveSpider){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+10,rx:24,ry:7};
  }
  if(e.animPack){
    var sh=Math.max(8,e.animPack.h*.28);
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+7,rx:sh,ry:Math.max(3,sh*.28)};
  }
  return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+sz*.50,rx:sz*.45,ry:sz*.18};
}

function ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,x,y){
  var g=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(e);
  if(!g)return Infinity;
  var p=ppaPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y);
  // Minkowski-style expansion by the player's own visible shadow radii.
  var rx=g.rx+(P.sz||60)*.38;
  var ry=g.ry+(P.sz||60)*.14;
  var dx=(p.x-g.cx)/Math.max(1,rx);
  var dy=(p.y-g.cy)/Math.max(1,ry);
  return dx*dx+dy*dy;
}

let PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE=[];
let PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT=0,PPA_NEAR_BODY_X=1e9,PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y=1e9,PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN=-1;
function ppaNearWorldBodies(){
  const now=(typeof performance!=='undefined'&&performance.now)?performance.now():Date.now();
  if(now-PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT>55||Math.abs(P.x-PPA_NEAR_BODY_X)>24||Math.abs(P.y-PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y)>24||PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN!==EN.length){
    PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT=now;PPA_NEAR_BODY_X=P.x;PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y=P.y;PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN=EN.length;
    const list=[];
    for(let i=0;i<EN.length;i++){
      const e=EN[i];
      if(!e||e.hp<=0||e.isClanBoss)continue;
      if(Math.abs(e.x-P.x)<=300&&Math.abs(e.y-P.y)<=300)list.push(e);
    }
    PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE=list;
  }
  return PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE;
}

function ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(x,y,fromX,fromY){
  const near=ppaNearWorldBodies();
  for(var i=0;i<near.length;i++){
    var e=near[i];
    // Small second broad phase around the proposed player position.
    if(Math.abs(e.x-x)>230||Math.abs(e.y-y)>230)continue;
    var q=ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,x,y);
    if(q<1){
      // If an older save/spawn already overlaps a body, always allow movement out.
      if(fromX!==undefined&&fromY!==undefined){
        var q0=ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,fromX,fromY);
        if(q0<1&&q>q0+.0001)continue;
      }
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function ppaScenePointWalkableForBody(x,y,r){
  if(P.scene==='dungeon')return dgCircleWalk(x,y,r);
  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    var c=SCENES.arena.center;
    return Math.hypot(x-c.x,y-c.y)<=460;
  }
  return true;
}

// Apply entity collision after the normal map/wall resolver. If the direct
// step is blocked, try one axis at a time so movement slides naturally around feet.
function ppaMoveWithWorldBodyCollision(x,y,dx,dy,r){
  var full={x:x+dx,y:y+dy};
  if(ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(full.x,full.y,x,y))return full;

  var mx={x:x+dx,y:y};
  if(ppaScenePointWalkableForBody(mx.x,mx.y,r)&&ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(mx.x,mx.y,x,y))return mx;

  var my={x:x,y:y+dy};
  if(ppaScenePointWalkableForBody(my.x,my.y,r)&&ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(my.x,my.y,x,y))return my;

  return{x:x,y:y};

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);

function fartToggleAutoMining(){
  if(P.scene!=='fartzone')return;

  if(!INV.fartPickaxe){
    showPickup('Нужна кирка · купи у шахтёра за 200 PPA','#ffcf6b');
    fartAutoButtonUpdate();
    return;
  }

  const mine=fartNearestMine(FART_MINE_RADIUS);
  if(!mine){
    showPickup('Подойди ближе к руднику','#d8bc7b');
    fartAutoButtonUpdate();
    return;
  }

  if(fartMineHasLivingGuard(mine)){
    showPickup('Сначала уничтожь всех стражей рудника','#ff8c78');
    fartAutoButtonUpdate();
    return;
  }

  if(FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining&&FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId===mine.id){
    fartStopAutoMining('Авто добыча выключена');
  }else{
    FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining=true;
    FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=mine.id;
    FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=mine.id;

    const label=mine.type==='gold'
      ?'золота'
      :(mine.type==='ppa'?'PPA':'ресурсов');
    showPickup('⛏ Авто добыча '+label+' включена','#9dff91');
  }
  fartAutoButtonUpdate();
}

function updateFartZoneSystem(){
  if(P.scene!=='fartzone'){
    const b=document.getElementById('fartAutoMineBtn');
    if(b)b.style.display='none';
    return;
  }
  if(!FART_ZONE_STATE.ready)fartInitZone();

  const now=Date.now();
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(250,now-(FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick||now)));
  FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick=now;

  // Individual guard respawns: exactly 30 minutes after death.
  for(let i=FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const q=FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns[i];
    if(now<q.at)continue;
    const mine=fartMineById(q.mineId);
    if(mine)fartSpawnGuard(mine,q.index);
    if(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object'){
      delete INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(q.mineId,q.index)];
    }
    FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.splice(i,1);
    try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
  }

  // Production is explicit now: Auto Mining + purchased pickaxe are both required.
  FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=null;
  if(FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining&&!INV.fartPickaxe){
    fartStopAutoMining('Нужна кирка — добыча остановлена');
  }
  if(FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining&&INV.fartPickaxe){
    const mine=fartMineById(FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId);
    if(!mine){
      fartStopAutoMining(null);
    }else{
      const d=Math.hypot(P.x-mine.x,P.y-mine.y);
      if(d>FART_MINE_RADIUS){
        fartStopAutoMining('Ты отошёл от рудника — добыча остановлена');
      }else if(fartMineHasLivingGuard(mine)){
        fartStopAutoMining('⚔ Стражи вернулись — добыча остановлена');
      }else{
        FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=mine.id;
        fartMineTick(mine,dt);
      }
    }
  }

  fartAutoButtonUpdate(false);
}

}

function gnomeFireCannonball(){
  // Select ONCE at the moment of the shot. No target search is done in the
  // projectile update loop.
  let target=null;
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e)})||null;
    if(target){
      const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
      if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>playerBasicRange()+edge)target=null;
    }
  }
  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=7;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  const muzzleX=P.x+dx/dist*24;
  const muzzleY=P.y-7+dy/dist*10;
  PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.push({
    x:muzzleX,
    y:muzzleY,
    vx:dx/dist*speed,
    vy:dy/dist*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target
  });

  // Very small game-layer muzzle kick so firing while running still reads
  // clearly without adding effects into the sprite sheet.
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    PT.push({
      x:muzzleX,y:muzzleY,
      vx:dx/dist*(1.2+i*.45)+(Math.random()-.5)*.6,
      vy:dy/dist*(1.2+i*.45)+(Math.random()-.5)*.6,
      life:6,ml:6,sz:1.5+i*.45,
      col:i===0?'#ffd36a':'#c47a32'
    });
  }
  return true;
}
function updatePlayerCannonballs(){
  // Extremely small loop: move each ball toward the coordinates captured at
  // fire time. At arrival, use the game's already proven damage routine.
  for(let i=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS[i];
    b.x+=b.vx;
    b.y+=b.vy;
    b.remaining-=Math.hypot(b.vx,b.vy);

    if(b.remaining<=0){
      const t=b.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }
      }
      PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}
function drawPlayerCannonballs(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const b of PLAYER_CANNONBALLS){
    const x=b.x-cam.x,y=b.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-24||y<-24||x>_vw+24||y>_vh+24)continue;
    cx.save();

    // Small but clearly readable cannonball on a phone screen.
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(214,125,42,.30)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,10,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.fillStyle='#24272b';
    cx.strokeStyle='#d68a3d';
    cx.lineWidth=2;
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,7,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();cx.stroke();

    cx.fillStyle='rgba(255,221,155,.75)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x-2,y-2,2,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.restore();
  }
}

// === V141 ARCHER BASIC ARROW ==============================================
const PLAYER_ARROWS=[];

function archerFireArrow(){
  let target=null;

  // Prefer the target already locked by Smart Attack.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){
      return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e);
    })||null;

    if(target){
      const range=playerBasicRange();
      if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&target.isClanBoss){
        if(clanBossDistanceFromBody(target,P.x,P.y)>range)target=null;
      }else{
        const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
        if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>range+edge)target=null;
      }
    }
  }

  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=12;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  // Start near the bow hand / chest rather than from the character's feet.
  const startX=P.x+Math.cos(ang)*20;
  const startY=P.y-18+Math.sin(ang)*8;

  PLAYER_ARROWS.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:Math.cos(ang)*speed,
    vy:Math.sin(ang)*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target,
    ang:ang
  });

  // Tiny bow release read; deliberately light, no glow spam.
  PT.push({

function archerFireArrow(){
  let target=null;

  // Prefer the target already locked by Smart Attack.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){
      return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e);
    })||null;

    if(target){
      const range=playerBasicRange();
      if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&target.isClanBoss){
        if(clanBossDistanceFromBody(target,P.x,P.y)>range)target=null;
      }else{
        const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
        if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>range+edge)target=null;
      }
    }
  }

  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=12;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  // Start near the bow hand / chest rather than from the character's feet.
  const startX=P.x+Math.cos(ang)*20;
  const startY=P.y-18+Math.sin(ang)*8;

  PLAYER_ARROWS.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:Math.cos(ang)*speed,
    vy:Math.sin(ang)*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target,
    ang:ang
  });

  // Tiny bow release read; deliberately light, no glow spam.
  PT.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:-Math.cos(ang)*.7,vy:-Math.sin(ang)*.7,
    life:5,ml:5,sz:1.5,col:'#d8c18b'
  });
  return true;
}

function updatePlayerArrows(){
  for(let i=PLAYER_ARROWS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const a=PLAYER_ARROWS[i];
    a.x+=a.vx;
    a.y+=a.vy;
    a.remaining-=Math.hypot(a.vx,a.vy);

    if(a.remaining<=0){
      const t=a.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }

        // Small pixel impact only.
        for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
          PT.push({
            x:t.x+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            y:t.y-8+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            vy:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            life:7,ml:7,sz:1.3+Math.random(),
            col:j===0?'#e9e1c6':'#8a6b42'
          });
        }
      }
      PLAYER_ARROWS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}

function drawPlayerArrows(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const a of PLAYER_ARROWS){
    const x=a.x-cam.x,y=a.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-28||y<-28||x>_vw+28||y>_vh+28)continue;

    cx.save();
    cx.translate(x,y);
    cx.rotate(a.ang);

    // Pixel-like wooden shaft.
    cx.fillStyle='#b98b55';
    cx.fillRect(-10,-1,16,2);

    // Pale metal arrow head.
    cx.fillStyle='#d9dde0';
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(10,0);
    cx.lineTo(5,-3);
    cx.lineTo(5,3);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();

    // Small dark-green fletching matching the ranger palette.
    cx.fillStyle='#556b3b';
    cx.fillRect(-11,-3,4,2);
    cx.fillRect(-11,1,4,2);

    cx.restore();
  }
}

// Joystick — V38: one dedicated pointer owns movement.
// This prevents a second finger on ATTACK from becoming touches[0]
// and pulling the character toward the right-side attack controls.
let jA=false,jX=0,jY=0,jPointerId=null;
const jB=document.getElementById('joyB'),jS=document.getElementById('joyS');
const joy=document.getElementById('joy');

function resetJoystick(pointerId){
  if(pointerId!==undefined&&pointerId!==null&&jPointerId!==null&&pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  jA=false;jPointerId=null;jX=0;jY=0;
  jS.style.left='37px';jS.style.top='37px';
}
function updateJoystickFromPointer(e){
  if(!jA||e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=joy.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx=r.left+r.width/2,cy=r.top+r.height/2;
  let dx=e.clientX-cx,dy=e.clientY-cy;
  const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),mx=50;
  if(d>mx){dx=dx/d*mx;dy=dy/d*mx}
  jX=dx/mx;jY=dy/mx;
  jS.style.left=(37+dx)+'px';jS.style.top=(37+dy)+'px';
}
function jPointerDown(e){
  // Ignore extra fingers: only the first pointer that starts on the joystick owns it.
  if(jPointerId!==null)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  // V139: joystick no longer cancels Smart Attack.
  // While the player is steering manually, target lock remains active.
  jPointerId=e.pointerId;jA=true;
  try{joy.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  updateJoystickFromPointer(e);
}
function jPointerMove(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  updateJoystickFromPointer(e);
}
function jPointerEnd(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  try{if(joy.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))joy.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  resetJoystick(e.pointerId);
}

joy.addEventListener('pointerdown',jPointerDown,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointermove',jPointerMove,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointerup',jPointerEnd,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointercancel',jPointerEnd,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',e=>{if(e.pointerId===jPointerId)resetJoystick(e.pointerId)});
addEventListener('blur',()=>resetJoystick());
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)resetJoystick()});

function startSmartAttack(target){
  if(!target)return false;
  SMART_ATTACK.active=true;
  SMART_ATTACK.targetId=target.id;
  P.tid=target.id;

  // V140: NEVER reset/recenter the joystick when Smart Attack starts.
  // If the player is already holding movement, keep jX/jY and pointer ownership
  // exactly as-is. Smart Attack only supplies auto-movement when joystick is neutral.
  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)>0.001){
    P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
    P.meleeAng=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  }
  return true;
}

function updateSmartAttackInput(){
  if(!SMART_ATTACK.active)return null;

  const target=smartAttackTarget();
  if(!target||!targetIsValid(target)){
    cancelSmartAttack();
    P.tid=null;
    return null;
  }

  P.tid=target.id;
  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(.001,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=Math.atan2(dy,dx);

  const joystickActive=Math.hypot(jX,jY)>0.08;

  if(smartAttackDistance(target)<=smartAttackReach(target)){
    // In range: fire once when cooldown is ready.
    // Joystick keeps controlling movement; we do NOT force the hero to stop.
    if(P.shootCD<=0){
      attackQueued=true;
      cancelSmartAttack();
    }
    return joystickActive ? null : {x:0,y:0};
  }

  // If the player is steering, keep the target locked but let joystick movement
  // remain fully authoritative. When joystick returns to neutral, auto-approach
  // resumes toward the same target.
  if(joystickActive)return null;

  // No manual input: run directly toward the selected mob.
  return {x:dx/dist,y:dy/dist};
}

  var hpPet=Math.max(0,Number(P.hpRegen)||0);
  var mpPet=Math.max(0,Number(P.mpRegen)||0);
  if(!hpPotion&&!mpPotion&&!hpPet&&!mpPet){_premiumRegenCarry=0;return}
  _premiumRegenCarry+=dt;
  if(_premiumRegenCarry<1000)return;
  var ticks=Math.min(2,Math.floor(_premiumRegenCarry/1000));
  _premiumRegenCarry-=ticks*1000;
  var hpPer=(hpPotion?5:0)+hpPet,mpPer=(mpPotion?5:0)+mpPet;
  if(hpPer>0&&P.hp<P.mhp)P.hp=Math.min(P.mhp,P.hp+hpPer*ticks);
  if(mpPer>0&&P.mp<P.mmp)P.mp=Math.min(P.mmp,P.mp+mpPer*ticks);
}

var PET_FOLLOW={x:0,y:0,scene:'',phase:0,dir:'S'};

function resetPetFollower(){
  PET_FOLLOW.x=P.x-(P.face||1)*50;PET_FOLLOW.y=P.y+22;PET_FOLLOW.scene=P.scene;PET_FOLLOW.phase=0;PET_FOLLOW.dir='S';
}
function updatePetFollower(){
  var it=INV&&INV.equipped?INV.equipped.pet:null;if(!it)return;
  if(PET_FOLLOW.scene!==P.scene||Math.hypot(PET_FOLLOW.x-P.x,PET_FOLLOW.y-P.y)>330)resetPetFollower();
  var mv=Math.hypot(P.vx||0,P.vy||0),dxn,dyn;
  if(mv>.15){dxn=(P.vx||0)/mv;dyn=(P.vy||0)/mv}
  else{var pf=playerFacing4();dxn=pf==='E'?1:pf==='W'?-1:0;dyn=pf==='S'?1:pf==='N'?-1:0}
  var tx=P.x-dxn*52-dyn*16,ty=P.y-dyn*52+dxn*16+10;
  var dx=tx-PET_FOLLOW.x,dy=ty-PET_FOLLOW.y,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  var step=Math.min(dd,Math.max(1.7,Math.min(6.3,dd*.11)));
  if(dd>1){PET_FOLLOW.x+=dx/dd*step;PET_FOLLOW.y+=dy/dd*step;
    if(Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx))PET_FOLLOW.dir=dy>0?'S':'N';else PET_FOLLOW.dir=dx>0?'E':'W'}
  PET_FOLLOW.phase+=(dd>1.2?.34:.09);
}
function getCachedImage(src){
  if(!src)return null;if(!getCachedImage.cache)getCachedImage.cache={};var c=getCachedImage.cache;
  if(!c[src]){var im=new Image();im.src=src;c[src]=im}return c[src];
}

function equipFromBag(idx){
  var it=INV.bag[idx];if(!it)return;

    showPickup('Только для класса: '+(it.className||CLASS_DISPLAY[it.classKey]||it.classKey),'#ff7777');return;
  }
  INV.bag.splice(idx,1);
  var prev=INV.equipped[it.slot];
  INV.equipped[it.slot]=it;
  if(prev)INV.bag.push(prev);

  if(it.slot==='pet'){
    resetPetFollower();showPickup('🐾 Пет надет · автосбор лута включён','#8dff9a');
  }else if(it.slot==='wings'){
    showPickup('🪽 Крылья надеты','#c990ff');
  }else if(it.slot==='cloak'){
    showPickup('🧥 Плащ надет','#d6b176');
  }else if(it.slot==='artifact'){
    showPickup('🔮 Артефакт надет','#c990ff');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}
